newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai govt to facilitate finance mergers - minister.
newsitem.headline: Thai govt to facilitate finance mergers - minister.

text.p: Thai Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan on Monday said the Bank of Thailand was reviewing ways of facilitating mergers of cash-strapped finance companies but he declined to spell out how the authorities would achieve the goal.

"The Bank of Thailand needs to make mergers easier to help ease problems (in the sector). Mergers should be made to strengthen organisations concerned but whether they place will also depend on their own decisions," Amnuay said.
The central bank has denied press reports that it would ask the government to issue a royal decree forcing 30 small finance firms to merge.
Amnuay said the government was prepared to relax rules hampering mergers in the industry which has been weakened by heavy loan exposure to the ailing property sector.
He said the authorities were reviewing regulations on individual shareholding limits, cross directorships, and other restrictions governing the industry.
Thailand has about 91 finance companies licensed to take public deposits by issuing promissory notes. -- Bangkok newsroom (662)-6520642
